messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected on /v1/chat/stream - p95 ~1.2s (SLO 500ms), p99 ~8.9s (SLO 2s). Error rate rising. Paging oncall rotation. Incident id INC-2026-0315-47

oncall: ack — I'm on it. Which service is hot?

mike_sre: seeing preproc-service (prompt assembler) CPU spike to 95%, queued requests ~120, backlog climbing. Streaming tail latency correlates with preproc latency. sample trace id trace/0f3a7c9b

emma_prod: multiple customers reporting streaming stalls and truncated JSON outputs. They all use json-mode + complex tool schemas.

daren_engine: I merged a change yesterday that expanded tool schema expansion in templates (PR #4321). Could blow up tokens for nested schemas. Investigating.

oncall: ok mike, take lead. I'll coordinate comms.

mike_sre: mitigation plan (hot):
- flip json-mode off for streaming endpoints via env flag
- route affected orgs to compact preproc path (no expansion)
- scale preproc +2 replicas
- enable template cache TTL 60s

liz_support: which customers affected so support can notify?

emma_prod: impacted orgs: acme-alpha, beta-analytics, toolsmith-inc. Raising tickets and a short advisory now.

mike_sre: executing changes:
`kubectl -n prod set env deployment/preproc ENABLE_JSON_MODE=false TEMPLATE_CACHE_TTL=60`
`kubectl scale deploy preproc --replicas=5`
Gateway routing override posted for listed orgs to set header X-Preproc-Mode: compact for /v1/chat/stream (override id ov-3321).

incident-bot: Actions recorded. Severity set to Sev2. Pager rotations notified.

mike_sre: immediate effect: queue length dropping 120 -> 20 in ~2m. p99 fell from 8.9s -> 1.8s. p95 back to ~450ms. Some in-flight streams still stall until connections close.

emma_prod: support advisory sent to impacted accounts. No customer escalations yet.

daren_engine: dug into assembler logs: recursive schema expansion happening when tool schemas reference other tools. Complexity is near O(n^2) token blowup in worst cases. Reverting PR #4321 to stop eager expansion.

mike_sre: revert applied, rolling restart preproc: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/preproc`

oncall: summary for handoff: mitigations applied - json-mode disabled for streaming, routing override in place, preproc scaled, PR reverted. p99 reduced to ~1.2s and stable for 5m after changes.

sophia_night: ack — taking watch. Will escalate if p99 > 2s again or queue > 50.

liz_support: keeping tickets open pending stability window. Will update customers that a mitigation is live and a fix is in progress.

mike_sre: immediate action items for postmortem: add template complexity guard, add unit/regression test to prevent combinatorial expansion, add canary gate for json-mode changes, improve dashboards to surface preproc queue and template expansion metrics. Assign daren_engine owners.

daren_engine: taking ownership. ETA for fix+tests 2 days. Will implement lazy expansion and add synthetic canary.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-47 moved to monitoring state. Close if stable for 1h.

sophia_night: will close if green at 01:30Z. :thumbsup:
